Game Overview

In EggQuest, the core idea is straightforward: race against time in EggQuest, where quick thinking and nimble reflexes are crucial. Outwit clever crows, dodge deadly traps, and navigate hazardous terrain to collect precious bird eggs. The escalating challenge keeps you on edge, demanding strategic foresight and sharp maneuvering for a triumphant egg haul.
